overview_description.description: Modern Health is a mental well-being platform for innovative companies offering therapy, coaching, and self-guided courses all in one app. The platform combines the WHO well-being assessment, self-service wellness kits, a network of certified coaches, and licensed therapists available in 35 languages all available in a seamless app. It empowers employers to charge in acknowledging that mental health is just as important as physical health, destigmatizing the conversation, and increasing the accessibility of mental health services for all.

about_short_description.short_description: Modern Health is a mental well-being platform for companies offering therapy, coaching, and self-guided courses.

product.name: Modern Health Mental Health Platform
product.description: A cloud-based enterprise mental health platform that connects employees and dependents with personalized self-guided resources, coaching, therapy, group support, and crisis care.

product.name: Therapy and Psychiatric Care
product.description: Evidence-based virtual therapy and behavioral health care delivered by licensed providers, with care pathways that can address moderate to complex mental health needs.

product.name: Coaching
product.description: One-on-one coaching from certified coaches for personal development, resilience, work-related challenges, and everyday mental well-being.

product.name: Digital Resources and Self-Guided Programs
product.description: Self-guided digital exercises, tools, and programs that help members build coping skills, resilience, and healthy mental well-being habits without requiring a provider match.

product.name: Circles by Modern Health™
product.description: Provider-led group sessions focused on shared mental health and workplace topics, including stress, leadership, belonging, and current events.

product.name: Crisis Support and Care Navigation
product.description: 24/7 crisis resources and care navigation that help members access immediate support and escalate to appropriate clinical services when necessary.
